schema.description: Object with `summary`, `request`, `response`, `request_body` / `response_body` (the decoded body text: de-chunked, decompressed, markup kept; null when absent or binary), `view`, `request_protobuf` / `response_protobuf` (gRPC and Protobuf bodies as editable text, one `@message` per gRPC message, with `grpc-status` / `grpc-message` when present; absent for other traffic), plus `request_truncated` / `response_truncated` when cut and `request_b64` / `response_b64` with `bytes=1`. When rules or an edit in the intercept queue changed the traffic, `request` is what was sent to the server and `response` is what the server sent, as always; `request_original` is the request as the client sent it and `response_delivered` is the response as delivered to the client (text, cut by `max` like the others, with `*_truncated`; also `request_original_b64` / `response_delivered_b64` with `bytes=1`; each absent when unchanged). `changes` lists what changed them (`phase`, `by` rule, intercept or hook, `name`, optional `note`; empty when nothing did). `diffs` has one line diff per changed message (`phase`, `from_label`, `to_label`, `lines` in the shape of `/tools/compare`): the request from the client's to the one sent, the response from the server's to the delivered one. The `view` carries `request_original` and `response_delivered` too, redacted and marked untrusted for agents.
